title: Historical Date Converter
openIssues: France, Denmark-Norway, Soviet Russia, Spain, Portugal, Scotland's 1600 new year and the famous-date backgrounds (Washington, Newton, October 1917) rest on search-result sources named by the critic (no URLs kept, pages not opened); shipped labelled 'as of 2026-10-13, per search results'. A verifier who opens the pages or finds two separate result entries each could promote them to plain fact.

SPEC.md sections 1-12 run about 8,000 words against the 900-1,500 guideline; kept deliberately so two parallel builders need no guessing. Trim candidates if wanted: About-panel lists, critic answers, golden ViewModel examples.

Optional features listed first in the cut-list (days-between, 'none' place, Copy link, custom place, extra famous dates) may be dropped by the builders if the clock demands; the spec says what must survive.
The explainer is about 1,090 words (minimum 250) because the owner asked for more concept explanation; the artisan may wrap lines at about 100 characters but must paste the words exactly.
